facts.fact: IMS, with the NIA, Ghana Refugee Board and UNHCR, expanded the refugee national ID registration exercise to the Western and Volta regions, after a 2023 rollout in Greater Accra; no number registered is stated.
Refugees in Ghana can obtain the national identity card under the programme, with the cost subsidised for them, per IMS.

systems.owner: Identity Management Systems with National Identification Authority, Ghana Refugee Board, UNHCR
